articles.summary: Bit Digital, Inc. (NASDAQ: BTBT) announced today that it will release its Fiscal Year 2024 results on Friday, March 14, 2025, before the stock market opens. Senior management will host a live webcast and conference call to review that day at 10:00 a.m. ET.
articles.title: Bit Digital, Inc. Announces Date for Fiscal Year 2024 Financial Results and Conference Call

articles.summary: Bit Digital, Inc. (NASDAQ: BTBT) announced today that subsidiary WhiteFiber, a leading provider of high-performance GPU cloud infrastructure, and Shadeform, the premier multi-cloud GPU marketplace have entered a strategic partnership to bring on-demand NVIDIA B200 GPUs to customers beginning in April.
articles.title: WhiteFiber and Shadeform Announce Strategic Partnership to deliver on-demand access to NVIDIA B200 GPUs

articles.summary: Bit Digital, Inc. (NASDAQ: BTBT) announced its financial results for Fiscal Year 2024. In conjunction with the Company’s transition to domestic filer status, Bit Digital filed its 10K report with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (“SEC”) on March 14, 2025.
articles.title: Bit Digital, Inc. Announces Fiscal Year 2024 Financial Results
